transcript.text: In this video, we'll be going over everything that you want to do before RuneScape Dragon Wild's full release.
To start off the video, we'll be going over your account and character progression. The most obvious one here
is that you'll want to be making sure to beat the entirety of the Umbral Sands biome. The main reason this is important
is because if you don't do it, you won't be able to progress into the later portions of the game that'll be coming
out with launch. If you're not sure if you're done, just know that if you've beaten the dragon boss that is inside
the Umbral Sands biome, then you have indeed completed all the current content that you will need to do before being
able to progress. After that is that you'll want to make sure each and every one of your different fighting skills
such as attack, ranged, and magic are all at least level 40 or higher. The reason this is important is because we
don't know what kind of resistances the boss will have and what fighting styles will be the best. Of course, go ahead
and level the one you like the most as high as possible, but getting each of them to at least level 40 unlocks some
unique skills that are usable by them as well as gets them high enough that you'll be able to do significant damage
without having to do grinding that you could have done beforehand. Next is that you'll want to make sure you get the new
agility skill to at least level 44 so that you unlock the phase dash ability. This is incredibly important as if you
don't have it, there is a very strong chance you will not be able to even progress all the way through the rest of
the game since it's likely there will be jump puzzles and different abilities you'll have to dodge that you will need
to have this skill to do. If possible, it's worth trying to actually get up to level 70 for the reactive recall ability
as it can easily save your life in a pinch when it teleports you away after taking lethal damage. Speaking of
important things when it comes to agility, it's also worth mentioning that you should probably try to unlock the
gilded gyre hawk amulet by getting gold on all currently available agility trials since the game will likely add
more agility trials for you to face in the full release. That means it's going to be a lot easier to obtain now than it
would be if you wait longer to get it. After that is that you want to get your construction to 40 so that you have
extra storage space that is accessible from anywhere in the world. If you haven't unlocked this ability yet, just
know that it will take quite a few law stones, but it is incredibly easy to level your construction as you can just
build a bunch of things and then delete them. Having an extra 20 or so slots for you to throw all your heavy items into
is going to save you a ton of time and a ton of resources from teleporting back and forth. Now, moving over to the
materials and gear side of what you'll want to prep before entering [music] the new content. First up is that you'll
want to unlock the Pharaoh's Scepter Staff, the Bow of Illdinis, and either the Zaros Cat home weapon or the
one-handed obsidian weapon variation of that. To top it off, you're of course going to need an anti-dragonfire shield
which you'll want to make out of the Umbral Sands biome dragon as it does give you the best stats available. Each
of these weapons can be a bit challenging to get, so alternatively, you can try to unlock whichever master
craft weapon is your favorite and buff it to the highest power level possible. Some great examples of very strong
master craft weapons that you could buff up are things like the crystal bow or the necromancer staff which have
extremely high damage outputs or possibly even the abyssal whip as it has one of the best unique abilities
available in the game. At the end of the day though, all that matters is that you have three extremely strong weapons to
go into this content as they have said it will be a little bit more challenging than everything we faced up until this
point. Speaking of which, you'll also want the best armor available for whatever weapon type you're primarily
using. Whether that's adamantite armor or Infinity robes or the Ranger red dragon armor is entirely up to you, but
just make sure you get it. More importantly, you'll want to make sure you have the fire cape unlocked as it is
by far the best item for this slot and you can get it by completing the hard mode fight caves. It's also incredibly
cool to look at, so that should be reason enough, but if you just want it for the stats, it's definitely worth the
grind. Since we will be facing the first ever raid, it's also going to be important for you to farm up a ton of
high HP food such as swabbie pie or pumpkin glaze sandwiches which provide some nice buffs. You will need to,
however, level your fishing and cooking pretty high for this, so make sure you get those out of the way now as if you
don't, you might find yourself grinding it out so that way you can survive the immense amount of damage that will be
coming out in the new raid. Another thing that a lot of people are probably going to overlook is that you want to
make sure you have enough resources saved up to build two to three teleport lodestones. Now, we don't know for sure
if we'll be able to place these down in the new zone, but it is very likely that we will be able to, so you'll want to
have enough resources to build these that way you're not constantly walking back and forth in case you accidentally
die. I know I've personally ran into this a number of times, so save yourself the runs and start getting enough
resources to build at least two or three and if not more. And this one is also pretty simple, but considering that it
will probably take a lot of fighting for us to get through the raid, you'll want to make sure you have more than enough
runes as well as the best quality arrows available for your weapon so that you are fully prepared and ready to dive
head first into the new content. There are, of course, some other things I probably didn't mention here that you
should be doing to prepare, but I'll I'll you guys mention those in the comments. And more importantly, if you
do want to learn how to get any of the Mastercraft items or any of the skills, either check out this video or check out
the videos down in the description below as we've made guides on every single one of them that you could possibly need.
